description: React component for managing channel groups in Mattermost, including listing, adding, removing, and changing roles of groups associated with a channel.

classes.name: ChannelGroupsManageModal
classes.description: React component class for managing groups within a channel, including listing, role assignment, and removal.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads groups associated with the channel, supports pagination and search.

methods.name: onClickRemoveGroup
methods.description: Removes a group from the channel and refreshes the list.

methods.name: titleButtonOnClick
methods.description: Opens the modal to add new groups to the channel.

methods.name: setChannelMemberStatus
methods.description: Changes the role of a group member to admin or member.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders a row for each group, including role toggle and remove options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main ListModal component with props.
